description.p: Bandu Workstation is an enterprise financial operations and core banking desktop client. Engineered for branch tellers, loan officers, and compliance accountants.

ul.li: High-throughput teller cash transactions and automated receipt dispatch
Hardware ESC/POS thermal printing with bidirectional line display support
Real-time ledger audit trails and double-entry bookkeeping safeguards
Encrypted offline journal queuing with automatic network synchronization
Rounded application branding and high-DPI icons
Native performance improvements for Linux and Windows
